mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth exceeds 3.0% on a year-over-year basis, it signals robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production and inflation (CPI) indicates a supply-driven inflationary shock that pressures corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and CPIAUCSL rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts and retail sales signals an impending slowdown in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.02.
